name: call-chip
title: Call Chip
description: A small inline chip naming an agent's tool call, its argument and an elapsed time. A translucent wash fills across the bar while it runs, then it turns green with a tick when done or red with a retry on failure.
use: An agent interface should show which tool is running, what it is doing and how long it takes.
avoid: The text is tiny and muted on a dark surface, and the timer needs a wide row to avoid crowding.
a11y: Status is announced and retry is a real button, but that button has no visible focus and the chip text is hidden from readers. (keyboard: partial, labels: good, reduced motion: respected)
looks: A stack of narrow dark rounded bars, each holding a tiny monochrome icon, a short bold tool name, a monospace argument and a right-aligned timer. Faint lighter fills sit inside the bars, and the rows are tightly stacked.
behaves: While a chip runs, a translucent wash creeps across its width toward the timer, which counts up in milliseconds. On completion the wash turns green and the icon rolls to a tick; on failure it turns red and the whole chip shakes.
customise: Props set the icon, tool name, argument, status, expected duration, size, colours, wash opacity, shake, timer visibility and a retry callback.
weight: light: A few chips; only the timer runs a frame loop, and only while a chip is running.
demo: Tool calls grep "TODO" src/, read src/app/checkout.tsx, bash npm run test -- --ci and edit src/lib/cart.ts.
issues: The tool name, argument and timer are hidden from screen readers; only a composed status sentence is read.
polishWhy: Clean chip with a nice progress wash; tiny muted text and near-identical frames.
